feature: Standardize focus ring colors across all form inputs
description: Form inputs across the application use inconsistent focus ring colors - some use blue-500, others use accent-9 or accent-7. This creates visual inconsistency and a disjointed user experience. All form inputs should use focus:ring-accent-9 for consistency with the design system.

phases.name: Replace blue-500 with accent-9
phases.description: Replace all instances of focus:ring-blue-500 (raw Tailwind color outside design system) with focus:ring-accent-9

subtasks.description: Replace focus:ring-blue-500 with focus:ring-accent-9 on lines 122 and 133 (search input and filter select)

standard.rationale: accent-9 is the primary accent color in the design system (#0090ff). Using this consistently for focus rings creates a cohesive visual language and improves accessibility by providing predictable focus indicators.
